summary: This directory acts as the central entry point for order-related business logic, providing essential utilities for identifier generation while serving as a unified module to expose shared order schemas and definitions to the rest of the application.
responsibilities: Generate unique identifiers for order entities
Consolidate and export shared order domain definitions
Provide a centralized interface for order-related operations
relationships: The order identifier generation utility relies on the underlying domain structures defined in the shared schemas.
The directory serves as a single source of truth for both order logic and data structure definitions.
designDecisions: Centralized export strategy to minimize consumer dependency paths
Separation of identifier logic from schema definitions
Module-based encapsulation for domain-specific business logic
